NOT CODE: the night's runtime edits are runLinkPhase extra_counters (R-IG; this step declares none, so no key and no behaviour change, lock type-counters T6) and descriptor/notes/guard text that no runner reads at run time; they move lib_fingerprint (fef97e27 -> 93b059a9) and source_fingerprint, not this output.
